flawed_step: Step 3: After colouring G-v with four colours, asserting that this colouring can always be extended to v is unjustified; the neighbours of v may collectively use all four colours.
assessment_summary: The induction starts validly: G-v remains triangle-free and is 4-colourable by the induction hypothesis. It fails at the extension step. Triangle-freeness makes the neighbourhood of v independent, but does not ensure that its vertices use at most three colours in an arbitrary proper colouring. Indeed, finite triangle-free graphs with chromatic number at least 5 exist, so the statement is false.
